name: Solowin Holdings Class A Ordinary Share
description: Solowin Holdings Ltd is an investor-focused, versatile securities brokerage company in Hong Kong. It offers a wide spectrum of products and services through its secure one-stop electronic platform. It is engaged in providing securities-related services, investment advisory services, and asset management services to customers. The operations were organized into four reportable segments: Corporate Finance Services, Wealth Management Services, Asset Management Services and Virtual Assets. It derives maximum revenue from Wealth Management Services.
